description: Spring Boot service: Hikari pool exhausted, then connection refused to Postgres in a Caused-by chain, 502s from the gateway, finally a heap OutOfMemoryError.
notes: Hikari 'Connection is not available' is a pool limit. First is the pool limit: the Hikari line reports the pool exhausted, and the timeout is how that showed up (relabelled in #73, when conn_limit joined the truth set).
